name: similarity
label: 语义相似度匹配
description: Compute semantic similarity between texts (local lightweight BGE embeddings): for every query take the top-k most similar targets with cosine scores; falls back to character n-gram vectors when the model is missing.

queries.description: query texts to match (e.g. every sentence the salesperson said)

targets.description: candidate target texts (e.g. the standard script library)

topK.description: number of nearest targets returned per query

threshold.description: similarity threshold (0-1); nothing below it is returned
